2607.28966.title: BLADE: Boundary-Expanded and Layer-Adaptive Dynamic Exit for Efficient LLM Reasoning
2607.28966.paper_summary: Large language models often improve task performance by generating long reasoning traces, but the resulting computation is frequently wasted on redundant verification and revision. Existing probe-based early-exit approaches mainly inspect explicit self-doubt expressions, leaving many earlier termination opportunities undetected. Expanding inspection to ordinary reasoning boundaries improves coverage, but also exposes highly diverse intermediate states whose predictive information may reside in different hidden layers. We present Boundary-Expanded and Layer-Adaptive Dynamic Exit for Efficient LLM Reasoning (BLADE), a lightweight framework that dynamically terminates reasoning by estimating whether the generated prefix is sufficient for correct answering. BLADE constructs multi-granular checkpoints from sentence, self-doubt, and paragraph boundaries, and derives robust training labels through repeated answer completions. It further learns a compact subset of informative probe layers instead of relying on fixed choices or expensive representations from all layers. At inference time, calibrated predictions are combined with checkpoint-specific confirmation rules to balance responsiveness and premature-exit risk. Experiments on five benchmarks and two Qwen3 reasoning models show that BLADE preserves near-baseline accuracy while reducing generated tokens by 24.8% on Qwen3-8B and 15.8% on Qwen3-4B. Ablation studies further confirm the benefits of diverse checkpoints and automatic layer selection, demonstrating an effective approach to more efficient LLM reasoning.
2607.28966.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型通常透過生成長的推理痕跡來改善任務表現，但隨之而來的計算往往浪費在冗餘的驗證和修訂上。現有的基於探針的早期退出方法主要檢查明確的自我懷疑表達，導致許多早期終止的機會未被發現。擴展檢查到普通推理邊界可以改善覆蓋率，但也暴露出高度多樣的中間狀態，其預測信息可能存在於不同的隱藏層中。我們提出了邊界擴展和層自適應動態退出以提高 LLM 推理效率（BLADE），這是一個輕量級框架，通過估計生成的前綴是否足以正確回答來動態終止推理。BLADE 從句子、自我懷疑和段落邊界構建多粒度檢查點，並通過重複的答案完成推導出穩健的訓練標籤。它進一步學習一個信息豐富的探針層的緊湊子集，而不是依賴於固定的選擇或來自所有層的昂貴表示。在推理時，經過校準的預測與檢查點特定的確認規則結合，以平衡響應性和過早退出的風險。在五個基準和兩個 Qwen3 推理模型上的實驗顯示，BLADE 在保持接近基線準確率的同時，減少了 Qwen3-8B 的生成標記 24.8% 和 Qwen3-4B 的 15.8%。消融研究進一步確認了多樣檢查點和自動層選擇的好處，展示了一種更有效的 LLM 推理方法。
